caveat: chosen on fold-model predictions; applying them to the frozen models (fitted on all 676 samples) assumes similar score distributions on new data
model_bundle: models/killcoyne_frozen_pkg_v1 (reported only; not written into that bundle)
population: all pre-event samples of the 676 samples from 80 patients of the Killcoyne discovery cohort with a matched H&E slide (571 samples, 75 patients)

rules.t_B: comparator (B): positive if L-LATE >= t_B (80% training sensitivity), needed for the triage criterion
rules.t_high: L-IMG > t_high -> flagged high risk (t_high = c*, 90% training specificity)
rules.t_seq: t_low <= L-IMG <= t_high -> sequenced; positive if L-LATE >= t_seq (80% sensitivity among training middle-band cases)
